citations.claim: EW yellow in progress at step 184, E wait reset to 0 while NS waits 63 s
first violating step 188: EW yellow cut to 4 s, now all-red before NS; E wait=1 restarting
NS starved: N wait 67 s at step 188 while EW yellow was preempted

counterfactual.change: Set actuated true->false (fixed-time); same steps/timings. Removes long-wait recall preemption of yellow, yellow runs full 6 s and no violation.

explanation: Actuated controller with long-waiting NS demand (N/S wait 59-67 s from step 180 to 188) truncates the active EW yellow: EW green ends at step 183, EW yellow runs steps 184-187 (4 s) then forced to all-red before NS at step 188, though yellow_seconds=6 requires >=6 s. The recall/max-wait logic preempts clearance intervals instead of only greens.
vision_note: Steps 185-187 show yellow signals on the EW approaches while NS approaches stay red with blue queued vehicles waiting. At step 188 all signals turn red, so the yellow lasts only about 3-4 s instead of the required 6 s.
